description: Create a cryptocurrency payment invoice to top up your Dominus Node wallet. Supports BTC, ETH, LTC, XMR, ZEC, USDC, SOL, USDT, DAI, BNB, and LINK. Returns a payment address and amount. Privacy coins (XMR, ZEC) provide anonymous billing — no identity linked to payment.

amount_usd.description: Amount in USD to add to wallet (min $5, max $1000)

currency.description: Cryptocurrency to pay with (BTC, ETH, LTC, XMR, ZEC, USDC, SOL, USDT, DAI, BNB, LINK)

name: dominusnode_pay_crypto
